description.blurb: This small moon of Jupiter was discovered in 2022 and announced in early 2023.
description.more: S/2022 J 2 is part of the Carme group, a tight cluster of retrograde irregular moons of Jupiter that follow similar orbits to Carme at semi-major axes between 22–24 million km (14–15 million mi), orbital eccentricities between 0.2 and 0.3, and inclinations between 163 and 166°. With a diameter of about 1 km (0.62 mi) for an absolute magnitude of 17.6, it is one of Jupiter's smallest known moons with confirmed orbits.
